title: [review] lora_ipv6_mesh-mkk4: rust/target/ build artifacts committed, .gitignore missing target/
description:
Commit d83cbc5 includes 3 build artifacts under rust/target/debug/:
- rust/target/debug/deps/lichen_gateway-f1ce66f1c4497e73.d (dependency file)
- rust/target/debug/incremental/lichen_gateway-22bf9b6an4f75/s-hkp20uavb7-14gy7hh-working/dep-graph.part.bin (4.2MB binary)
- rust/target/debug/incremental/lichen_gateway-22bf9b6an4f75/s-hkp20uavb7-14gy7hh.lock (empty lockfile)

Root cause: .gitignore has no entry for rust/target/. These build artifacts should never be tracked.

Fix: add "rust/target/" to .gitignore and remove these files from the index (git rm --cached).
